question: Scenario: I am reviewing Rambus's Q1 2025 growth and a proposed Q2 revenue estimate. Cite the SEC document and precise table/note/exhibit. Reuse prior-stage amounts without intermediate rounding; report percentages/ratios to two decimals and monetary derived amounts to three decimals unless specified.
